docs.title: Welcome to the AUC SSE HPC Cluster
docs.text:
The High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster at the American University in Cairo (AUC) School of Science and Engineering (SSE) provides state-of-the-art computational resources for research and education.

This documentation is divided into two primary sections:

  • User Guide: Information on how to log in, compile code, load environment modules, and submit batch jobs using the Slurm Workload Manager.
  • System Administration: Technical documentation regarding the deployment of KVM virtualization, NUMA alignment, Slurm database accounting, and storage networking.
